entries.title: Colossians 1:2
segments:
To the saints. This name was used to signify those who were set apart or consecrated-in the world but not of the world.
 

 
 At Colossae. Colossae, in the time of Paul was a small town in Phrygia, Asia Minor, a few miles southeasterly from Laodicea.  It is believed that Paul wrote the epistle while he was imprisoned at Rome.

entries.title: Colossians 1:7
segments: Of Epaphras. Paul's endorsement of the teachings of Epaphras shows that there were false teachers among the Colossians also.  These men seem to have followed the apostles about, devoting their energies to leading astray those who had already embraced Christianity.
